basis: Search on Booking.com for check-in 2027-02-15, check-out 2027-02-22, 2 adults, 1 room, USD. The 'total_7n_usd' is the number Booking.com prints for the whole 7-night stay for the room named in 'room'. Where Booking.com prints a tax-inclusive figure, that is what is used and 'tax_included' is true. Nothing is estimated.
